title: TmcPublicSpec
description: Local guard for the shape of the `public_spec` the mooc fixtures embed. The wire OpenAPI spec treats public_spec as an opaque blob (per the plugin architecture), but the CLI deserialises it into tmc-mooc-client's PublicSpec struct, so the fixture CONTENT must match the tmc editor/browser public spec shape. This schema mirrors that struct (crates/tmc-mooc-client/src/exercise.rs) and is NOT part of the OpenAPI contract.
